_README: Owned by the conversation designer. {placeholders} are filled by the code. Keep them in each message that lists them.
ask_order: Sure, I can help with that. What's your order number?
ask_email: Thanks. What email address did you use for the order?
verification_failed: I couldn't match that order number with that email. Could you double-check both?
out_of_scope: I can help with cancelling an order, requesting a refund, or tracking a shipment. What would you like to do?
thanks: You're welcome. Is there anything else I can help you with?
confirm_cancel: Order #{order_id} ({items}) is eligible for cancellation, and {amount} would go back to your original payment method. Would you like me to submit the cancellation request?
confirm_refund: Order #{order_id} is eligible for a refund of up to {amount}. Would you like me to submit the refund request?
denied: I can't do that for order #{order_id}. {reason}
approval_pending: I've prepared the {action_label} for order #{order_id}. A support specialist needs to approve it before it's completed. I'll update you here as soon as there's a decision.
approved_cancel: Your order #{order_id} has been cancelled. {amount} will return to your original payment method in 5 to 7 business days.
approved_refund: Your refund of {amount} for order #{order_id} has been approved. It will return to your original payment method in 5 to 7 business days.
rejected: A specialist reviewed your {action_label} for order #{order_id} and couldn't approve it. {reason_line}I can connect you with a person if you'd like to talk it through.
expired: Your {action_label} for order #{order_id} wasn't reviewed in time, so I've closed it. Would you like me to submit it again?
failed: I couldn't complete the {action_label} for order #{order_id} because something changed on the order. A specialist will follow up with you.
escalated: I've passed this to a support specialist. They'll follow up with you.
llm_error: I'm having trouble right now. A support specialist will follow up with you.
max_steps: I wasn't able to finish that. I've asked a support specialist to follow up with you.
